lines.line: Incognito mode makes me invisible online, right?
lines.adds_information: Two friends and a laptop show who believes what before the correction.

lines.line: Wrong. Your boss, school and Wi-Fi may still see.
lines.adds_information: Zoe’s certain face and the sticker name who can still see, which the voice only lists.
Dan’s shock face and a giant word make the jolt visible.

lines.line: It only hides history from your browser.
lines.adds_information: Google’s own page on screen is the source for the claim.
The fear face and a slow pull-out carry what the line only implies.
Zoe’s shrug lands the dry answer in the wider frame.

lines.line: Save this before incognito fools you. Comment HIDE.
lines.adds_information: The comment box shows the exact keyword to type.
